final_claim: For arbitrarily large \(M\), a block of exactly \(M\) consecutive dyadic quadratic modulations has weak-\(L^1\) operator norm at least \(c\log M\), witnessed by a smooth nonnegative unit-\(L^1\) test function with level \(c\log M/\sqrt M\) on a set of measure at least \(c\sqrt M\).
